base_image.role: ROCm 7.2.3 toolchain and runtime for gfx1201. Deliberately identical to the sibling production image: the patch series is the only variable under test.

llama_cpp.commit_subject: tests : adjust default threads for test-llama-context (#31157)
llama_cpp.note: This is the base the vendored patch series was exported against. It is newer than the sibling image's d812350 pin; the engine bump is unavoidable because the patches are git-am commits against this tree.

patch_series.name: rdna-boosts

excluded_blocks.09: host-resident MoE: iface, scheduler, expert cache, staging rings - MoE-only
excluded_blocks.10: slab / fusion dispatcher / async input ring infrastructure - consumed by 09 and 11
excluded_blocks.12: campaign remainder, mixed bag with no dependency from 00-08
excluded_blocks.13: opt-in MTP draft-vocabulary subset - requires a re-cut GGUF with draft_head tensors
excluded_blocks.14: TEMPORARY relaxed tensor-split mode - tensor split is not used by this deployment

patch_series.why_vendored: The upstream repository publishes a new release roughly hourly and its main branch is not a stable reference (r158 -> r161 observed inside one working session). Vendoring at a tagged commit keeps the build reproducible and independent of upstream churn.
patch_series.why_prefix_only: Verified by application testing on the pinned base: blocks 05, 08 and 13 fail to apply when blocks 01 and 04 are skipped. Blocks 00-08 are a contiguous prefix and apply cleanly in sequence. Subsets that skip mid-series blocks are not supported.

native_artifacts.reason: Every inference binary in this image is compiled from the pinned llama.cpp commit with the vendored series applied; nothing is inherited prebuilt.

build_config.cpu_isa_baseline: x86-64-v3 (AVX, AVX2, FMA, F16C; AVX-512 disabled)
build_config.avx512_guard: The build fails if libggml-cpu contains any AVX-512 (zmm) opcode. Re-proven after patching, because the series touches CPU paths too.

model.note: Engine image; GGUF model weights are provided at runtime through a read-only bind mount.

speculative_decoding.adaptive_mtp: Available from block 02 as an opt-in alternative: --spec-type draft-mtp-adaptive
speculative_decoding.dflash: Requires a compatible DFlash draft GGUF supplied with --model-draft.

new_knobs_from_patches.GGML_CUDA_GDN_CHUNKED: block 03 - chunked gated-delta-net prefill; set 0 for A/B against upstream
new_knobs_from_patches.GGML_HIP_FA_BAND_WMMA: block 05 - RDNA4 flash-attention band; this is the knob for head-256 / GQA-6 / q8_0 KV

runtime_contract.build_smoke_check: Parse representative multimodal MTP serving arguments with --help; no model weights or GPU hardware required. This is the guard against the engine bump removing a flag.
runtime_contract.hardware_qualification: UNQUALIFIED. Verify readiness, non-empty chat completions, tool calls, vision, memory stability, and decode/prefill throughput against the production baseline before any promotion.
